cover.hook: Instagram is offering creators up to $500K for long videos. Are you in?
cover.label: 5 social updates worth knowing right now

slides.headline: Instagram is [[offering to pay]] creators for long videos
slides.sub: Business Insider reports top offers for its Features product reached $500,000. Meta says it is funding Features content directly with some creators.
slides.source: Business Insider, via Social Media Today, Nov 1

slides.headline: more LinkedIn ads now [[feature creators]]
slides.sub: Year over year. LinkedIn's CEO also said paid video ads are up 25%.
slides.source: Microsoft earnings, via Social Media Today, Oct 29

slides.headline: in local spending [[started on TikTok]]
slides.sub: TikTok says 27 million Americans visited an independent restaurant, cafe or shop for the first time last year after finding it there.
slides.source: TikTok, via Social Media Today, Oct 28

slides.headline: growth in [[partnership ads]] year over year
slides.sub: Meta says ads run with creators and partners grew more than 97% in Q3 and passed a $15 billion annual run rate.
slides.source: Meta, via Social Media Today, Oct 28

slides.headline: search volume growth, [[down from 17%]]
slides.sub: Google says AI Mode queries are growing fast but monetize less. Where people search is shifting.
slides.source: Alphabet Q3 earnings, via Social Media Today, Nov 1

take.headline: Brands and creators are [[getting paid]] together
take.sub: Money is flowing to creator content on Instagram, LinkedIn and Meta ads. Build creator partnerships now.

cta.headline: Comment [[UPDATE]] and I'll send you the full list
cta.sub: All five updates, with the sources, in one place.

stories.name: story-thu
stories.headline: Meta's creator assistant now sends [[trend alerts]]
stories.sub: It flags trends in your niche, turns an idea into a storyboard and shot list, and drafts comment replies in your voice. Now on the web.

stories.name: story-fri
stories.headline: Do you work with [[creators]] in your marketing?
stories.context: LinkedIn says ads featuring creators are up 63% year over year.

stories.name: story-sat
stories.headline: views for YouTube [[microdramas]]
stories.sub: YouTube says microdramas passed 6.5 billion views in the first half of 2026.
stories.source: YouTube, via Social Media Today, Oct 27

stories.name: story-sun
stories.headline: Threads tests [[custom like buttons]]
stories.sub: Add your own image or animation that shows when people like your posts. Testing with select users in South Korea, Brazil and Indonesia.

stories.name: story-mon
stories.headline: Would you take a [[paid]] long video deal?
stories.context: Instagram is reportedly offering creators up to $500K for Features videos.

stories.name: story-tue
stories.headline: Local spending that [[began on TikTok]]
stories.sub: TikTok says 27 million Americans tried a new local business after finding it on the app.
stories.source: TikTok, via Social Media Today, Oct 28

stories.name: story-wed
stories.headline: Creators are the [[new ad channel]]
stories.sub: Partnership ads, creator ads, paid long form. Pick two creators and test a partnership this month.
